thread:
maya: Heads-up: planning a staged migration: v1 streaming payload change + embedding alias remap. Need docs owners for a migration playbook, tiny snippets, and CI smoke tests.
jon: Can you state the exact user-facing deltas so examples are accurate? :mag:
maya: Two main changes: (1) v1 streaming will stop emitting partial-token events for rwd-* models; switch to the v2 streaming shape (`json-chunks`). (2) Embedding aliases will be remapped (e.g., `embed-legacy` -> `models.embed-v2`). Update any sample embed calls.
elaine: I can take JS + Python snippets. I'll draft minimal streaming -> v2 examples and a short embed example.
jon: Small JS sketch to mirror:
```
// JS - v2 streaming
const s = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream_format: 'json-chunks' });
for await (const chunk of s) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta || ''); }
```
elaine: Will add the Python analogue and a note about `max_latency` default shifting.
sean: QA ask: add smoke tests that run snippets against canary and assert no 4xx and initial token latency <500ms. Suggest `docs/smoke/run_stream_migration.sh` to invoke each snippet.
maya: docs-bot: create a deprecation checklist for the playbook (snippets, redirects, banner, changelog, smoke, SDK warning).
docs-bot: Checklist created at `deprecations/staged_migration_checklist.md` and assigned to maya. :white_check_mark:
jon: Proposed timeline: snippets by Wed EOD, PRs open Fri, smoke green Mon, public notice next Wed. Tag me `@jon` in PRs for review.
maya: I'll open a meta PR that links sub-PRs and includes the checklist. Also will add a small alias -> replacement table in the PR description with cost notes. Ping if you want to split snippet ownership. :thumbsup:
